# pdf.js (vendored)

Mozilla PDF.js `3.11.174`, legacy (UMD) build, copied verbatim from
`https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pdfjs-dist@3.11.174/legacy/build/`.

Used only by the trombinoscope import: the files are lazy-loaded (injected as a
`<script>` tag) the first time a user picks a PDF, so they cost nothing on a
normal page load.

each file.
